property_summary: After acceptOwnership() is called by the pending owner, the owner() should return the new owner, not address(this).
When acceptOwnership() is called by anyone other than the pending owner, ownership does not change.
After acceptOwnership() is called by the pending owner, the new owner becomes the caller, and the previous owner is no longer the owner.
Paused() returns false after initialization and before any pause() call.
When no token-specific royalty is set, getRoyalties returns royaltyBPS === 500 and royaltyRecipient === the initialized royaltyRecipient.
When getRoyalties is called repeatedly for the same tokenId, it returns the same royaltyBPS value (i.e., the function is deterministic per tokenId).
The royaltyBPS returned by getRoyalties should be 500 when no token-specific configuration is set.
The royaltyBPS returned by getRoyalties for any tokenId must be 500 when no token-specific configuration exists.
For any tokenId, if getRoyalties returns a royaltyBPS of 500, the royaltyRecipient must be the initialized royaltyRecipient (address(this)), not zero.

For a token that does NOT have a custom royalty configuration set via _updateRoyalties, getRoyalties should return the default configuration with royaltyBPS = 500 and royaltyRecipient = royaltyRecipient.
If a token has a custom royalty configuration with royaltyBPS > 0 and royaltyRecipient != address(0), then getRoyalties returns that custom configuration, not the default.
getRoyalties returns the default configuration for tokens with royaltyBPS == 0 in the reference, but returns the custom configuration in the mutant.
For any token without a custom royalty configuration, getRoyalties returns the default (royaltyBPS=500, royaltyRecipient=recipient).
After acceptOwnership, getRoyalties returns different values for tokens whose custom configuration has royaltyBPS == 0.
When no royalty configuration is set for a token, getRoyalties returns the default royaltyBPS of 500 for the reference contract.
getRoyalties returns the default royaltyBPS of 500 when no override is set.
getRoyalties reverts with NotInitialized before initializeRoyalties is called.
When no custom royalty is set for a token ID, getRoyalties returns the default royaltyBPS of 500 in the reference contract.
The default royaltyBPS for an unconfigured token ID is 500

When getRoyalties returns the default configuration (500 bps) because token-specific royalties were not set, the configuration's royaltyRecipient should be the global royaltyRecipient (not address(0)).
After initializing royalties and setting no token-level royalty, getRoyalties(id) should always return the default recipient (the one set during initialization), never address(0).
If no token-specific royalties are set, getRoyalties(id) returns a configuration with royaltyRecipient equal to the global default (the one set during initialization), not the zero address.
After initialization, getRoyalties always returns a configuration with a non-zero royaltyRecipient if no token-specific royalties have been set.

If no token-level royalties are set, `getRoyalties` returns the exact default configuration (500 BPS and the global `royaltyRecipient`) rather than a configuration with `address(0)` as `royaltyRecipient`.
For any tokenId, the royaltyRecipient in getRoyalties() should match the address stored in royalties[tokenId] if that address is non-zero, otherwise it should match the default royaltyRecipient.
For any tokenId where the stored royalties[tokenId].royaltyRecipient is non-zero, getRoyalties() must return that same recipient, not the global default.
getRoyalties returns a config with zero royaltyRecipient if and only if the stored config has zero royaltyRecipient.
For any tokenId, getRoyalties(tokenId) returns the stored royaltyRecipient when it is non-zero, otherwise it returns the default royaltyRecipient.
getRoyalties returns the stored royaltyRecipient when it is non-zero, otherwise returns the default royaltyRecipient.
After acceptOwnership, getRoyalties for any tokenId returns a non-zero royaltyRecipient.
After acceptOwnership is called, getRoyalties for any tokenId returns a RoyaltyConfiguration with a non-zero royaltyRecipient.
After acceptOwnership is called, getRoyalties for any tokenId returns a RoyaltyConfiguration where royaltyRecipient is not the zero address.
After acceptOwnership completes, the royaltyRecipient returned by getRoyalties(tokenId) for any tokenId is not the zero address.
After acceptOwnership, the royaltyRecipient field of getRoyalties for any tokenId is not the zero address when no per-token override is set.
